name: beauty-coupon-list-7
summary: The WorldManager rebuilds the beauty-coupon list (Character's 0x107F -> the client's 0x107D) in a fixed 29-byte stack buffer: err + 6 {id, count} pairs. The 2026 client reads SEVEN pairs (tiers 1-6 + gender change). Move the buffer 12 bytes down the frame and copy the seventh pair.
status: BUILT 2026-09-23 with character/recipes/beauty-coupon-tier6 v2 (which sends the seventh pair). Statically verified.
why: CParserCharDB::fc_NC_CHAR_SET_STYLE_GET_INFO_DB_ACK (0x40C5F0), frame sub esp,0x24, stack cookie at ebp-4.
It copies Character's packet+8..+0x21 (err + 6 pairs) into a packet at ebp-0x24: length byte 0x1C, opcode
0x107D, err at -0x21, pairs -0x1F..-0x08, then sends 0x1D bytes. A seventh pair (4 bytes) would land on the
cookie, so the frame grows to 0x30 and every buffer displacement moves by -0x0C (buffer at ebp-0x30, ends
ebp-0x0F). Nothing else lives in this frame. The cave copies packet+0x22 (the seventh pair from Character,
beauty-coupon-tier6 v2) to ebp-0x13, pushes the new size 0x21 and the new buffer address, and resumes.
Why seven: the 2026 client's 0x107D handler (Fiesta.exe 0x757A00) reads err + 7 x {id, count}, and its
coupon chooser (0x755AD0) picks index max(grade)-1 - 5 for the 2026 Extravagant tier - or 6 for a gender
change. With six pairs, index 5 was the gender-change coupon and index 6 was past the packet: the client
refused Extravagant styles itself ('you need a beauty shop item or gender change item') without asking.
0x409A30, called first, only logs the session; nothing checks the incoming packet's length.
